run_create_vasp_inputs_relax: run the CLI to generate VASP relaxation input files from a directory of CIF files
run_create_vasp_inputs_static: run the CLI to generate VASP static calculation input files from CIF files
create_input_generator: create a RelaxSetGenerator or StaticSetGenerator from a YAML incar config file
refactor_create_input_generator: refactor create_input_generator to support additional VASP calculation types beyond relax and static
review_cif_parsing: review the CIF file parsing loop that reads structures using ASE and handles invalid files
